cues: Spring-loaded valve buttons rebound quickly, supporting crisp repeated notes without requiring the player to reset each control manually.
Optional pearl-like caps give the finger buttons a smooth contact surface during rapid passages.
A rolled bead around the bell's rim stiffens its edge and helps resist dents from everyday handling.
The relatively short air column responds quickly to articulation, making clean attacks especially noticeable in upper passages.
Fine lip adjustments move between neighboring resonances, letting a player connect notes without changing valve positions.
In standard notation, its written C sounds a whole step lower, so printed parts use transposition.
